properties.title: 41 Cooper Square opened as a new Cooper Union academic building

properties.title: Alice and Agate Courts Historic District was designated
properties.short_description: The NYC Landmarks Preservation Commission historic district map records Alice and Agate Courts Historic District, LP-2309, as designated on February 10, 2009.
properties.explanation: An official LPC action designated the named Brooklyn courts as a historic district.

properties.title: Alice Tully Hall reopened after renovation
properties.short_description: Lincoln Center records Alice Tully Hall reopening after its 2009 renovation and expansion, adding a glass lobby, cafe, bar, and cantilevered extension.

properties.title: Audubon Park Historic District was designated

properties.title: CCNY dedicated the Spitzer School of Architecture's new home

properties.explanation: A documented opening or public-use milestone was recorded for the named facility.

properties.title: Citi Field opened in Queens

properties.title: David Rubenstein Atrium began public programming
properties.short_description: Lincoln Center records the David Rubenstein Atrium beginning year-round free performances in 2009 as a privately owned public space.
properties.explanation: A redesigned public atrium and visitor gateway entered free cultural-programming use on Broadway near Lincoln Center.

properties.title: El Museo del Barrio reopened after renovation
properties.short_description: NYC Department of Design and Construction recorded El Museo del Barrio reopening on 17 October 2009 after renovation of its facade, courtyard, galleries, cafe, and shop.

properties.title: Fillmore Place Historic District was designated
properties.short_description: The NYC Landmarks Preservation Commission historic district map records Fillmore Place Historic District, LP-2333, as designated on May 12, 2009.

properties.title: Governors Island Picnic Point and promenade opened

properties.title: High Line Section 1 opened to the public

properties.title: Lamartine Place Historic District was designated

properties.explanation: An official LPC action designated the named Chelsea row-house area as a historic district.

properties.title: Lincoln Hospital opened a new Labor and Delivery Suite

properties.explanation: A documented opening or public-use milestone was recorded for the named facility.

properties.title: Museum of Chinese in America opened its Centre Street home

properties.title: Ocean on the Park Historic District was designated

properties.title: Prospect Heights Historic District was designated
